title: Reconcile MANE .5 vs BIAS .4 transcript and 30 NTHL1 overlap via canonical SPDI / fail-loud routing

revision.finding: MAJOR: the transcript/NTHL1 issue is a CURRENTLY ACTIVE committed production-path defect, not hypothetical. configs/acmg/tsc.yaml already enables edge_cases.non_mane_transcript=true (L95) with a TSC2-only genes map pinned .5; BiasTsvSource yields raw .4; pipeline check_out_of_scope_gene + check_edge_cases misroute the full TSC2 corpus (EDGE_CASE_ROUTED) and every TSC1 row (OUT_OF_SCOPE_GENE) if the current production pipeline is run on real .4 rows. Census 30-manual is a separate analysis, not proof the pipeline works. Added AC-C7: a mandatory regression loading the real committed config + representative real .4 BIAS rows through the actual bias_source/policy/pipeline path, demonstrating baseline misroute then corrected behavior while the 30 NTHL1 rows stay manual.

source_facts.census_arithmetic: bias_gene_transcript: TSC1|NM_000368.4=2249, TSC2|NM_000548.4=4339, NTHL1|NM_002528.6=30; TSC2 corpus 4369 == 4339 + 30; TSC1 corpus 2249 == 2249
source_facts.pins: configs/ingest/tsc.yaml: TSC1->NM_000368.5, TSC2->NM_000548.5 (MANE Select .5); mane_release 1.4; assembly GRCh38
source_facts.scope_predicates: scorer/policy.py check_edge_cases non_mane_transcript L67-76 (exact-string compare); check_out_of_scope_gene L103-116 (always-on)
source_facts.committed_defect: ACTIVE committed production-path defect (NOT hypothetical): configs/acmg/tsc.yaml enables edge_cases.non_mane_transcript=true (L95) with a TSC2-only genes map pinned NM_000548.5; BiasTsvSource.records yields the raw .4 transcript; pipeline.py check_out_of_scope_gene + check_edge_cases misroute the FULL TSC2 corpus (EDGE_CASE_ROUTED, .4!=.5) and every TSC1 row (OUT_OF_SCOPE_GENE, TSC1 not in scorer genes) to manual review if the current production pipeline is run on real .4 rows. Census 30-NTHL1-manual is a SEPARATE analysis, NOT proof the pipeline routes correctly.
source_facts.spdi_source: ingest/normalizer.py SeqRepoGenomicNormalizer.normalize emits genomic SPDI variant_id via bioutils.normalize EXPAND; transcript-version-independent; fail-loud REF_MISMATCH + ManualQueueItem routing already present

policy.version_delta: add TSC1 .5 to scorer scope; reconcile pure .4 vs .5 same-base delta for both TSC1/TSC2 via canonical genomic SPDI (reconciled_version_delta) -> NOT routed to manual review; version recorded as provenance. Baseline: the committed pipeline actively misroutes the full TSC corpus to manual on .4!=.5 (non_mane_transcript already enabled) + TSC1 out_of_scope; the fix must be demonstrated by a real-config/real-row/real-pipeline regression (AC-C7), not asserted.
policy.nthl1: 30 NTHL1|NM_002528.6 records (chr16p13.3 TSC2-region overflow) -> always-on out_of_scope_gene -> manual queue, excluded_from_scorer=True; never scored, re-attributed to TSC2, or classified
policy.base_mismatch: in-scope gene but different base accession -> fail-loud manual queue (no silent coercion, mirrors REF_MISMATCH)

tester.responsibility: Author AC tests (AC-C1..AC-C7) from slot 2 + slot-1 surfaces only. Assert census arithmetic, NTHL1 out-of-scope routing, SPDI version-invariance, fail-loud on base mismatch, AND the mandatory committed-pipeline regression (AC-C7) that drives real .4 BIAS rows through the real BiasTsvSource/policy/pipeline path to demonstrate the live baseline misroute then the correction, with the 30 NTHL1 rows staying manual. Reuse the normalizer's SPDI; never re-roll it.

doer.responsibility: Build the probe + reconciliation config + reconcile_transcript_identity + non_mane_transcript refinement, in sequence probe -> config -> policy. May add tests, never weaken; honor slot 3.

checker.responsibility: Re-verify all ACs; confirm the AC-C7 regression runs on the real committed config + real .4 rows through the real pipeline and pins the baseline misroute before proving the fix; confirm no blanket manual-review dump on version bump, no silent coercion, the 30 NTHL1 excluded and unclassified, SPDI reused not re-rolled, no fixture patch.
